name: job-application-portal
description: Job Application Management Portal (React + Express + PostgreSQL)

scripts.install:all: npm ci && npm ci --prefix backend && npm ci --prefix frontend
scripts.db:up: docker compose up -d db && wait-on tcp:localhost:${POSTGRES_HOST_PORT:-5433} -t 60000
scripts.db:setup: npm run db:up && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix backend && npm run lint --prefix frontend
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
